svg.aria-label: Four clients on your machine, the Cub chat page, claude-thor, opencode and openbatrangs, reach the Thor through Tailscale Funnel with the access key. thor-tigress-agent on port 8080 routes each request by the model it names: the Nano and Bolt to llama-server on 8079, Qwen3.6 NVFP4 to TensorRT Edge-LLM on 8081, and searches to SearXNG on 8888. vLLM on 8000, which serves Qwen3.8, is parked.
svg.text: Four clients, one agent, three models
The agent sends each request to the server that holds the model it names.
